help.title: Controls
help.drone: Left hand: W / S climb and descend, A / D turn. Right hand: ↑ / ↓ forward and back, ← / → slide sideways. Z / X tilt the camera, M flight mode (N / S / A).
help.plane: Left hand: W / S throttle up and down, A / D rudder. Right hand: ↑ nose down, ↓ nose up, ← / → bank. Hold S at idle on the ground to brake.
help.boat: W / S or ↑ / ↓ throttle and reverse · A / D or ← / → steer.
help.car: W / S or ↑ / ↓ accelerate and brake (reverse when stopped) · A / D or ← / → steer.
help.ugv: W / S or ↑ / ↓ drive and reverse · A / D or ← / → turn on the spot.
help.rov: Left hand: W / S rise and dive, A / D turn. Right hand: ↑ / ↓ forward and back, ← / → slide sideways. Z / X tilt the camera.
help.common: Space start / pause · F photo · G drop buoy · C where am I · B place story · V view · R restart · T time of day · P settings · H help. Gamepads and the on-screen pads or sticks also work.

tut.faqBattery: Battery is at {b}%. Plan to be back and landed with 20–30% left; cold, wind and fast flying drain it sooner.
tut.faqDefault: I am the built-in guide. I can help with take-off and landing, wind, battery, rules, this place and your mission. For free-form answers choose an on-device model or a cloud AI with your own key above.
tut.faqMission: Step {n} of {total}: {step}. Watch the highlighted marker on the minimap and slow down as you get close.
tut.faqNoMission: No AERO mission is running. Open Missions to pick one of 30 scenarios, or try the real photo spots here.
tut.faqNote: The built-in guide answers common questions from the live flight data without any AI.
tut.faqRules: In Taiwan stay below 120 m above ground, keep the drone in sight, avoid crowds, airports and restricted zones, and register drones of 250 g or more with the Civil Aviation Administration. Check the local rules in other countries.
tut.faqStory: Press B for the place story and C to see where you are.
tut.faqTakeoff: Press Space (or Start), the drone lifts to about 3 m. Climb with W, descend with S, turn with A / D; use the arrow keys to move. To land, descend slowly with S over open ground — landing protection slows you near the ground.
tut.needKey: Enter your API key first (it is stored only in this browser).
tut.windHigh: Wind {v} m/s with gusts to {g} m/s is too strong for a small drone. Stay low, keep close, or wait — or switch to a calmer weather preset.
tut.windOk: Wind {v} m/s (gusts {g} m/s) is fine for a small drone. Expect some drift: keep the nose into the wind and leave margin near obstacles.
